issue.title: Improve exception messages when user mocks a method declared on non-public parent
issue.body: Mockito does not support stubbing/verification of methods that are declared on a non-public parent class. This situation cannot be detected easily (see [issue 212](https://code.google.com/p/mockito/issues/detail?id=212)). However, we can improve the errors Mockito emits when invalid use of the API is detected.
